preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner to modify critical parameters
Contract must have tokens accumulated from transfer fees

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is a design flaw where _maxTxAmount (5M tokens) and numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity (300K tokens) are both less than _tTotal (150M tokens). This prevents proper liquidity addition because: 1) The owner cannot transfer all tokens in one transaction due to _maxTxAmount limit, 2) The swapAndLiquify mechanism may never trigger if contract balance stays below numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold. To demonstrate: 1) Check current balanceOf(contract), 2) Verify it cannot reach numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity through normal transfers, 3) Confirm swapAndLiquify cannot execute, 4) Owner can call setMaxTxPercent() to increase _maxTxAmount but this doesn't fix the fundamental design issue.
